title: 別碰我的圓

singer.name: 阿基米德
singer.look: Archimedes, a Hellenistic Greek scholar of Syracuse in Sicily in the third century BCE, about 59 years old, lean and wiry with warm olive skin, a slightly broad weathered face, deep-set dark brown eyes under heavy uneven brows, a pronounced nose with a small natural bump, thinning short curly salt-and-pepper hair with a receding hairline, and a dense short square salt-and-pepper beard with a lighter chin. He wears an undyed oat-colored knee-length belted Greek linen chiton, a muted deep rust-brown wool himation draped over the left shoulder and wrapped at the hips with the right arm free, bare calves, and simple dark brown flat leather sandals.
singer.studio_wear: He wears large black closed-back studio headphones over his curly hair. ONE thin black headphone cable comes out of the bottom of the RIGHT ear cup (the ear cup nearest the camera), hangs down behind his right shoulder and his back, reaches the floor behind his feet and trails along the floor out of the frame to the side, toward the control room - one continuous cable, never cut off, never floating in the air, not attached to the microphone or its stand; his hands are empty. He is STANDING upright on the floor the whole time; there is no chair or stool anywhere.
singer.desc: Archimedes, an elderly ancient Greek scholar (curly salt-and-pepper hair, short square grey beard, oat linen chiton with a rust-brown himation, black studio headphones)
singer.perform: Throughout the shot he sings like a sincere, heartfelt Mandopop ballad singer in a recording booth: he leans slightly toward the microphone, his head sways gently with the slow beat, his eyes are sometimes half closed on the long notes, and one hand rises slowly at chest height or lightly touches the side of the headphones; the movements are slow and soft.

studio.master: Photograph of an empty modern recording studio vocal booth set built for a one-take music video, horizontal 16:9. A seamless deep teal paper backdrop curves smoothly from the wall into the floor and fills the whole background. In the center stands one large-diaphragm condenser microphone with a silver body on a black boom stand at head height of a standing adult, with a round black pop filter in front of it; a coiled black headphone cable runs from the stand to the floor. Soft large key light from the front left, a gentle warm rim light from behind, smooth falloff on the backdrop, subtle floor reflection. Nobody in the frame, no other equipment, no furniture. No text, no logos, no brand names, no watermark. Photorealistic, sharp focus.
studio.keep: {ref} is the recording booth: keep exactly that seamless deep teal backdrop, the same silver condenser microphone on the black boom stand with the round black pop filter, and the same soft light; nothing else in the room.
studio.mic: MICROPHONE PLACEMENT AND SIZE: the boom stand is set so the microphone head is exactly at the height of his mouth and directly in front of his mouth, and his mouth points straight at the microphone - his face turns toward the microphone, NOT toward the camera; the round pop filter hangs between his lips and the microphone, about a hand-width from his lips. The microphone body (silver grille plus body, without the shock mount) is exactly as long as his face from chin to hairline, about 20 cm - not bigger, not smaller; the pop filter is about as wide as his face. The pop filter's round screen FACES HIS MOUTH: its flat face is perpendicular to the line from his lips to the microphone, so when he is seen from the side the pop filter looks like a narrow upright oval, almost edge-on, standing directly between his lips and the microphone - never a full round disk turned toward the camera, never beside his face. THE MICROPHONE RIG IS IDENTICAL IN EVERY SHOT: a black boom stand stands on the floor on the far side of the microphone, its boom arm reaches in from the right side of the frame and holds the silver microphone hanging in a silver spider shock mount. The pop filter's thin black flexible gooseneck is clamped onto the boom arm just behind the shock mount, hangs down in one smooth U-shaped curve under the microphone and rises to the bottom of the round screen - one continuous unbroken line. A black microphone cable comes out of the bottom of the microphone, hangs down in a loose curve, touches the vertical stand pole only on its lower third and runs straight down the pole to the floor (never coiled) - always visible, never missing. When the camera is in front of him, it stands a little to one side so the microphone and pop filter sit beside his mouth and do not hide his mouth or eyes.
studio.rig_keep: {ref} is a close-up of that same microphone rig: copy EXACTLY its parts and how they connect - the silver microphone in the spider shock mount on the black boom arm, the pop filter gooseneck clamped on the boom arm making a U-curve under the microphone up to the screen, and the microphone cable hanging from the bottom of the microphone STRAIGHT DOWN VERTICALLY, reaching the stand pole only on its lower third; in a close-up that part is below the frame, so the cable leaves the bottom edge of the frame without touching the pole. Only the size, angle and framing change with the camera.
studio.light: Soft large key light from the front left, gentle warm rim light from behind, the seamless deep teal backdrop with smooth light falloff.
studio.setting: A modern recording studio vocal booth with a seamless deep teal paper backdrop, one silver condenser microphone with a round black pop filter on a black boom stand.
studio.style: Photorealistic music video, cinematic shallow depth of field, soft studio lighting, natural skin texture, gentle film grain.
studio.keep_h3: The seamless deep teal backdrop, the silver condenser microphone, the round pop filter and the black boom stand keep exactly their shape, color, size and position; the headphone cable stays one continuous cable from the right ear cup down behind his back; the microphone cable and the pop filter arm stay connected exactly as at the start to the floor; the microphone stays directly in front of his mouth at mouth height and is as long as his face; the lighting does not change. No red, orange or glowing light appears anywhere; the headphones stay black, his skin and clothes keep exactly their colors from the first to the last frame, and the color tone of the whole picture never changes. The pop filter, the microphone and the stand stay solid and opaque the whole time, never become transparent, never double, and no second microphone or stand appears.

song_style.music3:
Genre: Mandopop piano ballad, heartfelt and bittersweet, warm and intimate, slow build to an emotional final chorus. BPM 76, key E-flat major.
Vocal: ONE solo male singer, warm and slightly weathered middle-aged baritone, gentle and sincere, Taiwanese Mandarin diction, every word clear. No choir, no duet, no rap.
Arrangement: solo piano intro; verses with piano and soft cello; choruses add strings and soft drums; bridge drops to piano only; last section builds with full strings, then ends on a quiet piano note. Western major-key pop harmony, no melisma, no vocal runs, no Middle Eastern or Indian scale.
song_style.yue: Chinese, Mandopop, piano ballad, emotional, heartfelt, warm male baritone vocal, sincere, clear diction, piano, strings, soft drums, slow tempo, 76 BPM

lines.sing: 那一天我泡進浴缸 水滿出來流了一地
國王的金冠有沒有攙銀 答案就在水裡
我忘了穿衣衝上大街 滿城的人都在看我
我只顧著大喊尤里卡 我找到了 我找到了
lines.show: 我只顧著大喊 Eureka　我找到了　我找到了

lines.sing: 他們笑我瘋 笑我太認真
可是誰懂 一個數字也會讓人心疼
別碰我的圓 我把一生都畫在裡面
九十六條邊 一步一步靠近你身邊
三點一四 我算了又算 你永遠差那一點
別碰我的圓 讓我把它畫完
給我一個立足點 我就舉起整個地球
國王不信 我用一條繩子拉著大船走
羅馬的船開進港口 我的鐵爪把它吊上天
有人說我用鏡子 點燃了整片海面
兩年的圍城 我守著敘拉古
城牆外的人 只想知道我在算什麼
別碰我的圓 我把一生都畫在裡面
九十六條邊 一步一步靠近你身邊
三點一四 我算了又算 你永遠差那一點
別碰我的圓 讓我把它畫完
城門破了的那個晚上 我還蹲在沙上
一個影子擋住我的光
我只說了一句 先別踩我的圓
他聽不懂我的話 更看不懂我的圓
我算得出球是圓柱的三分之二
卻算不出那一把劍 離我有多近
不要雕像 不要冠冕 墓碑上就刻一顆球 住在圓柱裡面
我算得出圓有多常 卻算不出自己還剩多少時間
